answer: An agent economy requires each identity to lock 100 tokens in protocol escrow for 30 days to receive one ticket in its job lottery. Agents named glacier, juniper, and zenith all face this rule. Creating 1,000 fake agents therefore requires locking 100,000 tokens simultaneously, because escrowed tokens cannot back another identity. Each extra entry costs the attacker additional capital, lost access to those funds, and exposure to token price declines.
